title: 🐱 Neel spells cat with three sounds... which letter comes first? #kids #spelling #phonics
title_alts: 🔤 Neel builds the word cat from three sounds you already know #kids #spelling
😺 Neel nearly writes C-A-P for cat... the three-sound check fixes it #kids #phonics
description_hook: One short word, three sounds, said slowly enough for a small child to copy. Sound out cat, then hunt for the word around your own house.

characters.name: Neel
characters.description: four-year-old boy, straight black hair with a fringe, mustard yellow t-shirt, small blue plaster on one knee

scenes.narration: Today we spell one small word out loud. That word is cat.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक छोटा शब्द बोलकर लिखना सीखेंगे। वह शब्द है कैट।
scenes.image_brief: A cream card printed with the lowercase letters c, a and t in large soft type, leaning against a blue cushion on a wooden bench, warm morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: Cat has three sounds. Cuh, ah, tuh. Again: cuh, ah, tuh.
scenes.caption: कैट में तीन आवाज़ें हैं। क्, अ, ट्। फिर से: क्, अ, ट्।
scenes.image_brief: Three wooden letter tiles reading c, a and t laid out in a row with wide gaps between them on a pale woven rug, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Here is a grey cat asleep on a sunny windowsill. Cat, cat.
scenes.caption: यह एक स्लेटी बिल्ली है, धूप वाली खिड़की पर सो रही है। कैट, कैट।
scenes.image_brief: A grey tabby cat curled asleep on a wide windowsill beside a small potted plant, warm afternoon light falling across its fur.

scenes.narration: Your turn now. Say the three sounds with me. Cuh, ah, tuh.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। मेरे साथ तीन आवाज़ें बोलो: क्, अ, ट्।
scenes.image_brief: The same three wooden letter tiles pushed close together on a low wooden table so they read cat, a soft yellow cloth behind them, bright even daylight.

scenes.narration: Three sounds, one word: cat. Every time, three sounds make cat.
scenes.caption: तीन आवाज़ें, एक शब्द: कैट। हर बार तीन आवाज़ें कैट बनाती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Wooden tiles spelling the word cat resting next to a soft grey toy cat on a pale rug, gentle sunlight from one side.

scenes.narration: Cat hides in other places too. Look: the storybook cover, the food bowl.
scenes.caption: कैट और जगहों पर भी छिपा है: कहानी की किताब पर, खाने के कटोरे पर।
scenes.image_brief: A storybook standing on a shelf with the word cat printed large on its cover, and on the floor below it a ceramic pet bowl with the word cat painted on the side, soft indoor light.

scenes.narration: Which one spells cat: C-A-T or C-A-P? The answer is C-A-T.
scenes.caption: कैट कैसे लिखते हैं: C-A-T या C-A-P? सही उत्तर है C-A-T।
scenes.image_brief: Two plain white cards side by side on a wooden table, the left card reading C A T and the right card reading C A P, a small green arrow on the table pointing at the left card, even daylight.

scenes.narration: We heard cuh, then ah, then tuh. Three sounds, one word: cat.
scenes.caption: हमने सुना क्, फिर अ, फिर ट्। तीन आवाज़ें, एक शब्द: कैट।
scenes.image_brief: Three wooden letter tiles c, a and t in a neat row on a wooden table with a grey cat sleeping on a cushion behind them, warm evening light.

title: ✨ Leela adds a silent e to cap... what word does she get now? #kids #spelling #phonics
title_alts: 🔤 Leela learns how one silent e turns cap into cape out loud #kids #spelling
🙈 Leela reads cape as cap and the word slips away... silent e fixes it #kids #phonics
refrain: Silent e, cap turns to cape
description_hook: A silent e says nothing and changes everything. Watch cap become cape, kit become kite, and tub become tube.

characters.name: Leela
characters.description: five-year-old girl, two short plaits tied with green bands, pink dungarees, a gap where one front tooth is missing

scenes.narration: Today we learn one little trick. It is the silent e.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक छोटी तरकीब सीखेंगे। यह है साइलेंट ई।
scenes.image_brief: A pale card on a wooden desk printed with one large lowercase e in soft grey, calm daylight coming from a nearby window.

scenes.narration: A silent e sits at the end. You never say it. Silent e.
scenes.caption: साइलेंट ई शब्द के अंत में बैठता है। इसे कभी बोलते नहीं। साइलेंट ई।
scenes.image_brief: A row of wooden letter tiles spelling c, a, p, e on a linen cloth, the last e tile a lighter colour than the other three, soft even daylight.

scenes.narration: Here is a cap hanging on a peg. Add an e, cape.
scenes.caption: यह एक कैप खूँटी पर लटकी है। ई जोड़ो, कैप बन गया केप।
scenes.image_brief: A blue cotton cap hanging on a wooden wall peg beside a folded red play cape, gentle afternoon light on the wall.

scenes.narration: Say both words with me, slowly. Cap. Then cape. Hear the change?
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ दोनों शब्द धीरे बोलो। कैप। फिर केप। फ़र्क सुना?
scenes.image_brief: Two small cards propped on a low white shelf, the left one reading cap and the right one reading cape, a plain wall behind them, bright soft light.

scenes.narration: Silent e, cap turns to cape. The e changes the a.
scenes.caption: साइलेंट ई, कैप बन जाता केप। यह ई, a की आवाज़ बदल देती है।
scenes.image_brief: A red play cape spread out on a bed with one small wooden e tile resting on the fabric, warm lamp light from a bedside table.

scenes.narration: Try kit, the sewing kit. Add an e and kit becomes kite.
scenes.caption: अब kit लो, सिलाई का किट। ई जोड़ो और किट बन गया काइट।
scenes.image_brief: A small sewing kit box open on a table showing thread spools and buttons, and beside it a paper kite with a long ribbon tail, soft window light.

scenes.narration: Now tub in the bathroom. Add an e and tub becomes tube.
scenes.caption: अब बाथरूम वाला टब। ई जोड़ो और टब बन गया ट्यूब।
scenes.image_brief: A white bathtub holding shallow water with a clear plastic tube resting across the tub edge, bright light through a frosted bathroom window.

scenes.narration: Which word has the silent e: pin or pine? Pine has it.
scenes.caption: किस शब्द में साइलेंट ई है: pin या pine? pine में है।
scenes.image_brief: Two cards on a wooden floor, the left card reading pin next to a metal safety pin, the right card reading pine next to a small pine cone, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Cap became cape. Kit became kite. Tub became tube. Silent e, cap turns to cape.
scenes.caption: कैप बना केप। किट बना काइट। टब बना ट्यूब। साइलेंट ई, कैप बन जाता केप।
scenes.image_brief: Five word cards laid in a row on a table reading cap, cape, kit, kite and tube, with a lighter coloured e tile at the end of the row, warm evening light.

title: 🤫 Omar hears s and h together... is that two sounds or just one? #kids #phonics #spelling
title_alts: 🔤 Omar finds the sh sound in a shoe, a ship and a woolly sheep #kids #phonics
🧦 Omar says sock when the word is shop... one sh sound sorts it #kids #spelling
description_hook: Two letters, one quiet sound. Hunt the sh sound through a shoe, a ship, a sheep and a shell, and say it out loud each time.
problem_domain: letter pairs that share one sound

characters.name: Omar
characters.description: five-year-old boy, curly dark brown hair, green hooded sweatshirt, one sock always slipping down

scenes.narration: Today we learn two letters with one sound: s and h.
scenes.caption: आज हम दो अक्षर सीखेंगे जिनकी आवाज़ एक है: s और h।
scenes.image_brief: Two large wooden letter tiles, one s and one h, lying well apart on a grey slate floor near a front door, soft daylight from the open doorway.

scenes.narration: Put s and h together and they say shhh. Shhh, shhh.
scenes.caption: s और h साथ आएँ तो बोलते हैं श्श्श। श्श्श, श्श्श।
scenes.image_brief: The same two wooden letter tiles s and h pushed together so their edges touch on the grey slate floor, reading sh, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Look at this shoe by the door. Shoe starts with shhh.
scenes.caption: दरवाज़े के पास यह जूता देखो। shoe की शुरुआत श्श्श से होती है।
scenes.image_brief: A single small canvas shoe with untied laces sitting on a woven doormat beside a wooden front door, morning light stretching across the floor.

scenes.narration: Say it with me now. Shhh, like a quiet library. Shhh.
scenes.caption: अब मेरे साथ बोलो। श्श्श, जैसे शांत पुस्तकालय में। श्श्श।
scenes.image_brief: A low library shelf packed with colourful picture books, a small white card reading sh propped upright in front of the books, calm indoor light.

scenes.narration: Two letters, one sound: shhh. S and h always say shhh.
scenes.caption: दो अक्षर, एक आवाज़: श्श्श। s और h हमेशा श्श्श बोलते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A canvas shoe and the two joined sh letter tiles resting side by side on a woven doormat, soft daylight from the doorway.

scenes.narration: A ship sails on water. Ship begins with shhh too.
scenes.caption: एक जहाज़ पानी पर चलता है। ship भी श्श्श से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small wooden toy ship floating in a shallow blue plastic tub of water on a tiled floor, bright daylight from above.

scenes.narration: A sheep stands in the field. Sheep begins with shhh.
scenes.caption: एक भेड़ मैदान में खड़ी है। sheep भी श्श्श से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A woolly white sheep standing in a green grassy field with a low wooden fence behind it, clear afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Now a shell on the beach sand. Shell, with shhh.
scenes.caption: अब समुद्र तट की रेत पर एक सीप। shell, श्श्श के साथ।
scenes.image_brief: A pale spiral seashell resting on damp beach sand with gentle low waves further back, bright soft sunlight.

scenes.narration: Which one says shhh: shop or sock? Shop says shhh.
scenes.caption: कौन बोलता है श्श्श: shop या sock? shop बोलता है श्श्श।
scenes.image_brief: Two cards standing on a wooden shelf, the left reading shop in front of a small toy corner shop, the right reading sock in front of a folded striped sock, a green tick mark beside the left card, even light.

scenes.narration: Shoe, ship, sheep, shell. Two letters, one sound: shhh.
scenes.caption: जूता, जहाज़, भेड़, सीप। दो अक्षर, एक आवाज़: श्श्श।
scenes.image_brief: Four things lined up on a wooden table: a canvas shoe, a small toy ship, a toy sheep and a spiral seashell, with the joined sh letter tiles in front of them, warm evening light.

title: 🐛 Rani finds u and g inside bug... which other words rhyme with it? #kids #spelling #rhyming
title_alts: 🔤 Rani turns mug into rug and bug by changing just one letter #kids #spelling
🍯 Rani almost rhymes mug with jam... the ug ending shows the mistake #kids #phonics
refrain: Change the front, keep the ug
description_hook: One little ending, four everyday words. Keep the ug and swap only the first letter to get mug, rug, bug and jug.

characters.name: Rani
characters.description: five-year-old girl, short bobbed black hair, orange t-shirt with a pocket, one red hair clip above her ear

scenes.narration: Today we learn one word ending. It is u, g: ug.
scenes.caption: आज हम शब्द का एक अंत सीखेंगे: u और g, यानी अग।
scenes.image_brief: Two wooden letter tiles u and g resting side by side on a wooden kitchen table, a folded checked cloth behind them, warm morning light.

scenes.narration: Ug sounds like this: ug. Two letters, u and g. Ug.
scenes.caption: अग की आवाज़ ऐसी है: अग। दो अक्षर, u और g। अग।
scenes.image_brief: The same u and g tiles on the kitchen table with a small white card reading ug propped just behind them, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Here is a striped mug of warm milk. M plus ug: mug.
scenes.caption: यह धारीदार mug गरम दूध से भरा है। m और अग मिलकर mug।
scenes.image_brief: A striped blue and white mug filled with warm milk standing on a wooden kitchen table, faint steam rising, warm morning light.

scenes.narration: Say mug with me once. Muh, ug. Now try it faster.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ एक बार mug बोलो। म्, अग। अब ज़रा तेज़ बोलो।
scenes.image_brief: The striped milk mug on the kitchen table with the u and g tiles lined up beside it and a spare m tile placed in front, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Change the front, keep the ug. Mug keeps its ug.
scenes.caption: आगे का अक्षर बदलो, अग वही रखो। mug में अग है।
scenes.image_brief: The word mug spelled out in wooden letter tiles directly next to the striped milk mug on the kitchen table, gentle light from one side.

scenes.narration: Swap the m for r. Rug, on the floor. Swap it for b. Bug, in the garden.
scenes.caption: m की जगह r रखो: rug, फ़र्श पर। अब b रखो: bug, बगीचे में।
scenes.image_brief: A patterned woven rug on a wooden hallway floor, and at the edge of the rug a green potted plant with a small brown beetle on one leaf, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Which rhymes with mug: jug or jam? Jug rhymes with mug.
scenes.caption: mug के साथ कौन तुक मिलाता है: jug या jam? jug मिलाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two cards on a kitchen counter, the left in front of a glass jug of water and reading jug, the right in front of an open jar of jam and reading jam, a green tick mark beside the jug card, even light.

scenes.narration: Mug, rug, bug, jug. Change the front, keep the ug.
scenes.caption: mug, rug, bug, jug। आगे का अक्षर बदलो, अग वही रखो।
scenes.image_brief: Four things arranged in a row on a wooden kitchen table: a striped mug, a small rolled rug, a toy beetle and a glass jug, with the ug letter tiles in front, warm evening light.

title: 🔔 Jai spots double l at the end of bell... why two, not one? #kids #spelling #phonics
title_alts: 🔤 Jai learns why bell, ball and doll always end with two l's #kids #spelling
😮 Jai writes b-e-l and the word looks wrong... here is the fix #kids #phonics
description_hook: Some short words hide a second l at the end. Count the l's in bell, ball and doll, and say each word out loud.
problem_domain: double letters at the end of words

characters.name: Jai
characters.description: five-year-old boy, cropped wavy black hair, blue t-shirt with a pocket, a red string bracelet on one wrist

scenes.narration: Today we learn a spelling habit. Short words end in double l.
scenes.caption: आज हम लिखने की एक आदत सीखेंगे। छोटे शब्द दो l से ख़त्म होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden shelf holding a small brass bell, with two matching wooden letter tiles both reading l standing beside it, warm morning light.

scenes.narration: Two l's sit at the end. You hear one sound. Double l.
scenes.caption: दो l अंत में बैठते हैं। सुनाई एक ही आवाज़ देती है। डबल l।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical wooden l tiles placed touching each other on a pale wooden shelf, a plain cream wall behind them, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Here is a brass bell on the shelf. B, e, double l.
scenes.caption: यह पीतल की घंटी शेल्फ़ पर रखी है। b, e, और दो l।
scenes.image_brief: A small brass bell with a dark wooden handle standing alone on a pale wooden shelf, warm light from a side window.

scenes.narration: Say bell with me. Bell. Now count the l's: two.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ bell बोलो। bell। अब l गिनो: दो।
scenes.image_brief: The brass bell on the shelf with four letter tiles spelling b, e, l, l laid in a row in front of it, bright even light.

scenes.narration: Two l's, one little sound. Bell needs both of them.
scenes.caption: दो l, एक छोटी आवाज़। bell को दोनों चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: The brass bell beside the two touching l tiles on the shelf, the other letter tiles pushed slightly to one side, gentle afternoon light.

scenes.narration: A ball in the garden ends the same way: b, a, double l.
scenes.caption: बगीचे की गेंद भी ऐसे ही ख़त्म होती है: b, a, और दो l।
scenes.image_brief: A red and white football resting on green grass in a sunny garden beside a low flowerbed, clear midday light.

scenes.narration: A doll on the bed too. D, o, double l.
scenes.caption: बिस्तर पर रखी गुड़िया भी। d, o, और दो l।
scenes.image_brief: A soft cloth doll with yellow wool hair propped against a pillow on a neatly made bed, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Which is right: b-e-l or b-e-l-l? Bell takes two l's.
scenes.caption: सही क्या है: b-e-l या b-e-l-l? bell में दो l लगते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two cards standing on a wooden shelf, the left reading B E L and the right reading B E L L, a green tick mark beside the right card, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Bell, ball, doll. Two l's, one little sound.
scenes.caption: bell, ball, doll। दो l, एक छोटी आवाज़।
scenes.image_brief: Three things in a row on a wooden shelf: a brass bell, a small football and a cloth doll, with two l tiles standing in front of them, warm evening light.

title: 🦆 Farah ends duck with c and k... which one makes the sound? #kids #spelling #phonics
title_alts: 🔤 Farah finds the ck ending in duck, sock, clock and rock #kids #spelling
⏰ Farah writes duk for duck... the ck ending stops that mistake #kids #phonics
refrain: c then k, one kuh sound
description_hook: Two letters at the end of a word, one single sound. Find the ck ending in duck, sock, clock and rock.
problem_domain: letter pairs at the end of words

characters.name: Farah
characters.description: four-year-old girl, long dark hair in a high ponytail, yellow raincoat, a small star sticker on her hand

scenes.narration: Today we learn a letter pair at the end: c, k.
scenes.caption: आज हम अंत में आने वाली अक्षर जोड़ी सीखेंगे: c और k।
scenes.image_brief: Two wooden letter tiles c and k standing apart on the flat white edge of a bathtub, bright light from a frosted bathroom window.

scenes.narration: Together c and k say kuh. Just one sound. Kuh, kuh.
scenes.caption: c और k मिलकर बोलते हैं क्। बस एक ही आवाज़। क्, क्।
scenes.image_brief: The c and k tiles pushed together on the bathtub edge with a small white card reading ck propped behind them, bright even light.

scenes.narration: Here is a yellow rubber duck in the bath. Duck: d, u, ck.
scenes.caption: यह पीली रबर की बत्तख नहाने के पानी में है। duck: d, u, ck।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow rubber duck floating in shallow warm water inside a white bathtub with a few soap bubbles around it, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Say duck with me. Duh, uh, kuh. One more time.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ duck बोलो। द्, अ, क्। एक बार और।
scenes.image_brief: The yellow rubber duck sitting on the bathtub edge with four letter tiles spelling d, u, c, k lined up beside it, bright bathroom light.

scenes.narration: c then k, one kuh sound. Duck ends with ck.
scenes.caption: पहले c फिर k, एक क् की आवाज़। duck का अंत ck से होता है।
scenes.image_brief: The yellow rubber duck beside the two joined ck tiles on the flat white edge of the bathtub, soft light from the window.

scenes.narration: A striped sock in the drawer. Sock ends with ck too.
scenes.caption: दराज़ में धारीदार मोज़ा। sock का अंत भी ck से होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A striped red and grey sock lying folded in an open wooden drawer among other folded clothes, soft bedroom light.

scenes.narration: A round clock on the wall. Clock ends with ck.
scenes.caption: दीवार पर गोल घड़ी। clock का अंत भी ck से होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A round white wall clock with black hands and plain numbers hanging on a pale blue wall, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Now a smooth rock in the garden. Rock, with ck.
scenes.caption: अब बगीचे में चिकना पत्थर। rock, ck के साथ।
scenes.image_brief: A smooth grey rock sitting on dark garden soil beside green leafy plants, clear afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Which ends with ck: truck or train? Truck ends with ck.
scenes.caption: किसका अंत ck से है: truck या train? truck का अंत ck से है।
scenes.image_brief: Two cards propped on a wooden floor, the left reading truck in front of a small red toy truck, the right reading train in front of a blue toy train, a green tick mark beside the left card, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Duck, sock, clock, rock. c then k, one kuh sound.
scenes.caption: duck, sock, clock, rock। पहले c फिर k, एक क् की आवाज़।
scenes.image_brief: Four things lined up on a wooden bench: a yellow rubber duck, a striped sock, a small round clock and a smooth grey rock, with the ck letter tiles in front, warm evening light.

title: Mira confuses the word sun for son... why does it matter? #kids #spelling #phonics
title_alts: Sun is hot, spelled S-U-N
Confusing sun and son loses the heat, learn the right way
description_hook: Master the spelling of sun to distinguish it from similar words and understand its meaning.

characters.name: Mira
characters.description: 3 years old, pigtails, red shirt, holding a kite

scenes.narration: Today we spell the bright word sun.
scenes.caption: आज हम सूरज की वर्तनी करेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A large yellow sun shining brightly in a clear blue sky.

scenes.narration: It has S, U, N. S, U, N. Clear and bright.
scenes.caption: इसमें S, U, N होता है। साफ और चमकीला।
scenes.image_brief: Three large letters S, U, N floating in the sky next to the sun.

scenes.narration: The sun warms the green grass below.
scenes.caption: सूरज नीचे हरी घास को गर्म करता है।
scenes.image_brief: Sunlight hitting a patch of green grass in a park, no people.

scenes.narration: Say the letters: S, U, N. Say it now.
scenes.caption: अक्षर कहें: S, U, N। अभी कहें।
scenes.image_brief: The sun with a speech bubble containing the letters S U N.

scenes.narration: S-U-N shines bright.
scenes.caption: S-U-N चमकता है।
scenes.image_brief: The word SUN written in bold yellow letters radiating light.

scenes.narration: A yellow bee flies toward the sun.
scenes.caption: पिछली मकड़ी सूरज की ओर उड़ती है।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow and black bee flying towards the sun, in the sky.

scenes.narration: A shadow moves across the pavement.
scenes.caption: सड़क पर एक छाया चलती है।
scenes.image_brief: A long shadow stretching across a concrete pavement, sunlight source visible.

scenes.narration: Is it S-U-N or S-O-N? It is S-U-N.

scenes.image_brief: Two text options S-U-N and S-O-N, with a sun icon next to S-U-N.

scenes.narration: Sun has S, U, N. S-U-N shines bright.

title: Nova mixes up pink, pink is a color... is it right or wrong? #kids #spelling
title_alts: Pink is a color, learn its letters P-I-N-K
Mixing up pink letters confuses kids, learn right now
description_hook: Discover how to spell pink correctly to avoid common mistakes in your everyday vocabulary.

characters.name: Nova
characters.description: 4 years old, curly hair, yellow dress, holding crayons

scenes.narration: Let's learn the letters for pink right now.
scenes.caption: चलो पिंक के अक्षर सीखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Bright pink crayon standing upright on a white table, soft daylight from the left.

scenes.narration: It is P, I, N, K. Say P, I, N, K.
scenes.caption: यह P, I, N, K है। कहे P, I, N, K।
scenes.image_brief: Large colorful letters P, I, N, K arranged in a row on a pastel background.

scenes.narration: A pink balloon floats gently in the room.
scenes.caption: गुलाबी गुब्बारा कमरे में तैर रहा है।
scenes.image_brief: A single pink balloon floating near a window in a sunny room.

scenes.narration: Say the letters with me now, P, I, N, K.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ अक्षर कहें, P, I, N, K।
scenes.image_brief: Close up of the pink balloon with the text P I N K appearing around it.

scenes.narration: P-I-N-K spells the color.
scenes.caption: P-I-N-K उस रंग की वर्तनी है।
scenes.image_brief: The word PINK written clearly over the floating pink balloon.

scenes.narration: A pink rabbit sits on the grass outside.
scenes.caption: गुलाबी खरगोश घास पर बैठा है।
scenes.image_brief: A cute pink toy rabbit sitting on green grass in a garden.

scenes.narration: A pink flower blooms in the garden.
scenes.caption: गुलाबी फूल बगीचे में खिल रहा है।
scenes.image_brief: A vibrant pink flower blooming in a sunny garden, no people.

scenes.narration: Is it P-I-N-K or B-I-N-K? It is P-I-N-K.
scenes.caption: क्या यह P-I-N-K है या B-I-N-K? यह P-I-N-K है।
scenes.image_brief: Two lines of text appearing: P-I-N-K and B-I-N-K, with a checkmark on P-I-N-K.

scenes.narration: Pink has P, I, N, K. P-I-N-K spells the color.
scenes.caption: पिंक में P, I, N, K है। P-I-N-K रंग की वर्तनी है।
scenes.image_brief: The pink balloon, rabbit, and flower together, with the letters P I N K at the bottom.

title: Kai misses the double F in off... what changes the meaning? #kids #spelling #words
title_alts: Off means away, spelled O-F-F
Missing the F in off changes the action, learn why
description_hook: Learn to spell off correctly to understand actions of moving away and stopping.

characters.name: Kai
characters.description: 4 years old, messy hair, green tee, holding a toy car

scenes.narration: We are learning to spell the word off.
scenes.caption: हम शब्द ऑफ़ की वर्तनी सीख रहे हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A toy car stopped at a red light sign, indoors.

scenes.narration: It is O, F, F. O, F, F. Two F's.
scenes.caption: यह O, F, F है। दो F आते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Three blocks showing O, F, and another F, with a highlight on the double F.

scenes.narration: A red car turns its lights off.
scenes.caption: लाल गाड़ी अपने लाइट अन कर देती है।
scenes.image_brief: A red lantern with its light dimmed out, on a shelf.

scenes.narration: Repeat with me: O, F, F. Go on.
scenes.caption: मेरे साथ दोहराएं: O, F, F।
scenes.image_brief: The lantern with the letters O F F appearing in the air.

scenes.narration: O-F-F means away.
scenes.caption: O-F-F मतलब दूर।
scenes.image_brief: The word OFF written with an arrow pointing away from the lantern.

scenes.narration: A phone screen goes dark and off.
scenes.caption: फ़ोन की स्क्रीन काली और बंद हो जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A smartphone lying face up with its screen black, on a bed.

scenes.narration: A video game closes, now it is off.
scenes.caption: वीडियो गेम बंद हो जाता है, अब यह ऑफ़ है।
scenes.image_brief: A gaming controller sitting next to a blank tablet screen, indication of power off.

scenes.narration: Is it O-F or O-F-F? It is O-F-F.
scenes.caption: क्या यह O-F है या O-F-F? यह O-F-F है।
scenes.image_brief: Text options O-F and O-F-F, with a checkmark next to O-F-F.

scenes.narration: Off has O, F, F. O-F-F means away.
scenes.caption: ऑफ़ में O, F, F होता है। O-F-F मतलब दूर।
scenes.image_brief: The lantern, phone, and controller together, with the text O F F at the bottom.

title: Leo misses the letter K in king... how do we fix it? #kids #spelling #letters
title_alts: King is a royal word, spelled K-I-N-G
Forgetting the K in king makes it wrong, learn here
description_hook: Learn the correct spelling of king to remember its royal sound and form every time.

characters.name: Leo
characters.description: 5 years old, straight hair, blue pajamas, holding a book

scenes.narration: We will learn to spell the word king.
scenes.caption: हम शब्द किंग की वर्तनी सीखेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A golden crown resting on a dark blue velvet pillow, soft warm light.

scenes.narration: It starts with K. K, I, N, G. K, I, N, G.
scenes.caption: यह K से शुरू होता है। K, I, N, G।
scenes.image_brief: Four large wooden blocks with letters K, I, N, G stacked in a tower.

scenes.narration: A shiny gold crown sits on the table.
scenes.caption: चमकदार सुनहरी ताज मेज पर है।
scenes.image_brief: A detailed gold crown sitting on a wooden table, centered frame.

scenes.narration: Repeat the letters aloud: K, I, N, G.
scenes.caption: अक्षर दोहराएं: K, I, N, G।
scenes.image_brief: The crown with large text K I N G floating above it.

scenes.narration: K-I-N-G is the king.
scenes.caption: K-I-N-G राजा है।
scenes.image_brief: The word KING written in bold gold letters next to the crown.

scenes.narration: A toy king holds a silver sword.
scenes.caption: खिलौना राजा एक चांदी तलवार पकड़े है।
scenes.image_brief: A small toy figure of a king holding a silver sword, standing on a shelf.

scenes.narration: A red scarf drapes over the throne.
scenes.caption: लाल शाल सिंहासन पर लटकी है।
scenes.image_brief: A majestic throne covered with a red scarf, in a castle room.

scenes.narration: Is it K-I-N-G or K-I-N? It is K-I-N-G.
scenes.caption: क्या यह K-I-N-G है या K-I-N? यह K-I-N-G है।
scenes.image_brief: Text options K-I-N-G and K-I-N appear, with a star over K-I-N-G.

scenes.narration: King uses K, I, N, G. K-I-N-G is the king.
scenes.caption: किंग में K, I, N, G आता है। K-I-N-G राजा है।
scenes.image_brief: The crown and toy king together, with the text K I N G at the bottom.
